topic: WWII German U-boat crew death rate and the 1943 turning point
title: Why 2 Out of 3 WWII U-Boat Crewmen Never Made It Home
description: A quick, AI-narrated look at one of WWII's deadliest jobs -- and the exact turning point that flipped the odds against German U-boat crews. #history #ww2 #shorts

hook_candidates.text: More than 2 out of 3 German U-boat crewmen in WWII never made it home.
Why did Nazi Germany's most feared weapon of 1940 become a floating coffin by 1943?
U-boats didn't lose the Battle of the Atlantic because they ran out of torpedoes -- they lost because Allied codebreakers could read their mail.
In one month in 1943, Germany lost more U-boats than in the two years before it combined.

beats.text: **More than 2 out of 3** German U-boat crewmen in WWII never made it home.
